office_does: A Skagit County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil claims up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Paul W Nielsen, appointed in 2024, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Skagit County District Court judge since March 2024 and the court's presiding judge; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed District Court judge by the county commissioners in February 2024; court commissioner 2021-2024 [S1]
Senior deputy prosecutor 2007-2020 handling felony cases [S1]
Listed as the court's presiding judge [S3]
